CREATE SEQUENCE s_attachment_type_id_seq
  INCREMENT 1
  MINVALUE 1
  MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807
  START 1
  CACHE 1;
ALTER TABLE s_attachment_type_id_seq OWNER TO postgres;

CREATE TABLE s_attachment_type
(
  id integer NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('s_attachment_type_id_seq'::regclass),
  code character varying NOT NULL DEFAULT 'na'::character varying(10),
  description character varying(200),
  status boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  CONSTRAINT s_attachment_type_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
WITH (OIDS=FALSE);
ALTER TABLE s_attachment_type OWNER TO postgres;

delete from s_attachment_type;

CREATE SEQUENCE bordereau_id_seq
  INCREMENT 1
  MINVALUE 1
  MAXVALUE 9223372036854775807
  START 1
  CACHE 1;
ALTER TABLE bordereau_id_seq OWNER TO postgres;

CREATE TABLE bordereau
(
  id integer NOT NULL DEFAULT nextval('bordereau_id_seq'::regclass),
  file bytea,
  file_name character varying(200),
  status character varying(50),
  description character varying(400),
  created_by integer,
  created_date timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  last_modified_by integer,
  last_modified_date timestamp without time zone DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT bordereau_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
WITH (OIDS=FALSE);
ALTER TABLE bordereau OWNER TO postgres;

update s_attachment_type set mime_type = 'text/plain' where code='txt';
update s_attachment_type set mime_type = 'application/pdf' where code='pdf';
update s_attachment_type set mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet' where code='xlsx';
update s_attachment_type set mime_type = 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document' where code='docx';
update s_attachment_type set mime_type = 'image/jpeg' where code='jpg';
update s_attachment_type set mime_type = 'image/jpeg' where code='jpeg';
